visibleChange: Areas now forward source GIT Appearance/GenericType facts into the existing Placeables process contract, backend resolves placeable/door model metadata from source placeables.2da/doortypes.2da/genericdoors.2da lookups, area-instance payload cache keys cannot poison normal Placeables mode, Area actions stay beside the area list, object/placeable adding is no longer buried below the area loader, canvas wheel events stay in the viewport, source GIT world-unit object coordinates are normalized into the same tile-space used by ARE TileList terrain, ARE TileList terrain remains visible as a source-backed tile layout even when some SET model metadata is incomplete, runtime canvas exposes aggregate backend render payload/modelUrl/fallback readiness for source GIT placeables and doors, Area object contracts preserve raw GIT TemplateResRef as resRef while avoiding double placeable prefixes such as plc_plc_*, the frontend HTTP Area adapter preserves resRef instead of dropping it before scene mapping, Areas queue backend render payload requests for placeables/doors with bounded concurrency instead of firing hundreds of process calls at once, the selected Area camera now frames real Aurora TileList plus GIT object bounds instead of relying only on declared width/height, shared Placeables/Door render payloads are now published under each source GIT scene object id so the Area renderer receives the backend payload for the exact placed instance, opening a selected Area now automatically runs backend tile process contract readiness for real SET/ARE modelResRef candidates instead of requiring a separate manual terrain readiness click, the runtime exposes shared Placeables renderer binding evidence both on the canvas container and on each Area object mesh userData, the Runtime HUD now shows Area PLC/DOR shared renderer payload/model/fallback counts directly, the canvas container emits a browser-readable shared renderer runtime snapshot for automated proof, the frontend Tile HTTP adapter now preserves backend sourceAsset/renderAssetContract from tile process results instead of stripping them during parsing, the Area tile process readiness produced from those backend contracts now flows into the canvas runtime/HUD as data-area-tile-process-runtime-* diagnostics and visible Tile process runtime/source/blocker lines, the canvas container emits a browser-readable aurora:areas:tile-process-runtime-snapshot event plus areaTileProcessRuntimeSnapshot JSON carrying real source/MDL/GLB/loader counts and backend blocker summaries, and backend Tiles now bind module-snapshot derived GLB/GLTF files from __aurora/derived/models/<resref> into renderAssetContract.modelAsset with a real /catalog/tiles/cache/:cacheKey/model delivery endpoint; if no derived model exists, the contract reports the expected derived object key instead of a generic loader-missing blocker. Frontend terrain now consumes backend AreaTileProcess renderAssetContract.modelAsset.deliveryUrl through the shared Placeables GLTF loader/cache, creates a terrain-backend-tile-models scene layer positioned at ARE TileList row/col/orientation/height transforms, exposes data-area-terrain-tile-model-* runtime counters, and keeps the bridge mesh only for tiles whose backend model delivery contract is still blocked. The terrain tile model runtime now emits aurora:areas:terrain-tile-model-runtime-snapshot and writes data-area-terrain-tile-model-runtime-* evidence plus scene.userData.auroraTerrainTileModelRuntimeSnapshot, so browser/runtime proof can verify terrain-backend-tile-models loaded/pending/bridge counts without relying on text-only claims. Terrain tile model runtime evidence now separates loaded, pending, failed, and bridge-only tiles; failed shared-GLTF-loader requests write data-area-terrain-tile-model-failed-count, data-area-terrain-tile-model-loader-error-sample, and tile_model_loader_failed blocker details into the browser-readable snapshot instead of leaving Areas stuck as unexplained pending. The Areas canvas now shows a visible loading/blocker overlay for terrain tile model runtime snapshots, keeps terrain blockers visible instead of hiding them when placeable pending queues finish, and shows a non-debug Area PLC/DOR placeholder alert with primitive fallback and missing payload counts so _IKEA-style placeholder scenes are visible as exact renderer blockers. The central Areas loading overlay is now a small neutral spinner with only the loading scope and x/y count, for example Modele kafli Areas 0/4 or Modele PLC/DOR n/m; technical terrain blockers remain in runtime snapshots/HUD instead of covering the scene. The Area PLC/DOR placeholder alert and Runtime HUD now render a compact issue summary with fallback and missing-payload counts instead of dumping every missing object id onto the canvas; full id lists remain available in the browser-readable shared renderer snapshot/dataset. While Areas or PLC/DOR assets are loading, the canvas now disables OrbitControls and marks data-area-canvas-interaction-blocked=asset-loading with the loading source, preventing expensive rotate/pan/zoom interactions until loading clears. The terrain renderer now adds a full scene-dimensions footprint layer named terrain-area-extent-footprint using AreaScene.width/height, and camera framing always includes declared Area dimensions before partial TileList/model coverage, so _IKEA displays the full 16x16 canvas extent instead of only the currently loaded small tile/model fragment.
hypothesisTested: _IKEA still had a frontend render bottleneck after backend process and asset-contract batching because repeated GIT instances cloned raw GLB models and re-ran bounding-box normalization per object. To reach the 60 second target, Areas needs to reuse Placeables-mode model presentations by normalized render facts and avoid disposing shared cached geometry while rebuilding the object layer.
disproofResult: Not disproven by frontend typecheck or the executable areas render contract loop gate. The Placeables GLTF loader now builds normalized model cache keys from model URL, objectRadius, and target max-axis factor, stores one normalized prototype per key, returns cloned normalized presentations to Areas, and marks shared GLB geometry so object-layer cleanup does not dispose cached geometry between _IKEA scene rebuilds.
